name: Oh Brother. . .
summary: "Oh Brother. . ." is an Alliance mission given by Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City. Distraught over a cave-in during an expedition into the depths beneath Moonbrook, Wilder asks adventurers to search the labyrinthine mines for his missing sibling, Foreman Thistlenettle, or recover his Explorers' League Badge.

sections.title: A Trapped Expedition
sections.body: Wilder Thistlenettle and his brother entered the cavernous subterranean tunnels beneath Moonbrook as members of a mining company. However, things turned catastrophic when hostile thieves swarmed the area and a violent cave-in sealed off the lower tunnels. Wilder managed to escape to Stormwind, but his brother and the rest of the crew were left trapped behind the rubble.

sections.title: The Grim Fate of Foreman Thistlenettle
sections.body: The truth awaiting any rescuer who pushes deep into the Deadmines tunnels is tragic. Foreman Thistlenettle did not survive the entombment; instead, dark energies stirring within the abandoned mines reanimated the unfortunate dwarf into an undead husk. Wandering the subterranean caverns alongside other restless corpses, the foreman retains only his prized Explorers' League Badge as a token of who he once was.

faq.q: Where do I start the quest "Oh Brother. . ."?
faq.answer: The quest is offered by Wilder Thistlenettle, who can be found in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.

Foreman Thistlenettle wanders the exterior mine corridors of the Deadmines, located beneath the town of Moonbrook in Westfall. He is in the undead-infested section of the tunnels outside the instance portal.

A cave-in trapped Foreman Thistlenettle and his mining party inside the caverns, and none of them have been heard from since. Finding him, or at least his badge, is the only way Wilder will learn his brother's fate.

faq.q: What item do I need to retrieve?
faq.answer: You need to retrieve Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge, which he always carried; find the foreman deep in the Deadmines tunnels and the badge will be with him.

faq.q: What was the expedition doing in Moonbrook?
aliases: why were the dwarves in westfall
faq.answer: The Thistlenettle brothers were members of a mining company working the vast mine beneath Moonbrook before being ambushed by Defias bandits and separated by a sudden tunnel collapse.

faq.q: Is this quest completed inside the Deadmines dungeon instance?
aliases: is oh brother inside deadmines instance
do i need a dungeon group
faq.answer: No, you do not need to zone inside the dungeon instance. Foreman Thistlenettle is an elite mob who roams the contested mine tunnels that lead up to the instance portal.

angles.text: The tragic demise of an Explorers' League foreman in human lands hits home for any dwarf who values brotherhood, stonecutting, and the League's tireless work.
The Deadmines are a blight on Stormwind's doorstep, and this quest shows how deeply the Defias and subterranean horrors have harmed innocent citizens.
